payload.comment: Evaluation report is internally consistent: confusion matrix rows sum to per-class supports (total 7180), diagonal sum 6392/7180 = 0.890251 matches reported accuracy, and all per-class precision/recall/F1 values verify correctly against the matrix. Macro metrics (precision 0.870877, recall 0.87288, F1 0.863665) are correct averages. Prediction artifact test_samples (7180) matches n_samples. Test metrics were not used in model selection (test_metrics_used=false confirmed in both best_configuration and search_report). Config hashes are consistent across artifacts. The only issue is the inherited cross-artifact documentation inconsistency: the preprocessing review comment states augmented_train_size 359984 (89996×4) while split_manifest records 269988 (89996×3); with augmentations [hflip, vfl
